row: APRS Physical Therapy is a physical therapist owned outpatient clinic with two location to serve the Bozeman and Gallatin Valley community.  This channel has been created in order to share information and physical therapist expertise to anyone who is looking for the latest and best practice guidelines in the rehabilitation world.
